public_rationale: On December 20, 2024, ARC Prize reported 75.7% for o3 at high efficiency on the 100-task ARC-AGI-1 semi-private evaluation set [e2]. On April 22, 2025, ARC Prize reported frequent failures to return outputs when testing released o3 at high reasoning on ARC-AGI-1; it excluded the high-reasoning runs from its leaderboard because coverage was insufficient [e1]. These execution failures support the narrow claim that released o3-high could not readily reproduce the December result during April release-period testing [e1, e2].
limitations: Incomplete April testing does not establish o3-high's full-set accuracy or an inherent capability ceiling [e1].
The cited evaluations do not establish reproducibility on other December benchmarks or performance after the April 1–23, 2025 target period [e1, e2].

For this ongoing observation, the target is the April release-period testing available before the post.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable release-period evaluations reliably reproduced approximately 75% with released o3 at high reasoning without substantial execution failures.
